description: Summarize device usage of the set of FILEs, recursively for directories.

option.name: --all
tip: write counts for all files, not just directories

option.name: --apparent-size
tip: print apparent sizes rather than device usage; although the apparent size is usually smaller, it may be larger due to holes in ('sparse') files, internal fragmentation, indirect blocks, and the like

option.name: --block-size
tip: scale sizes by SIZE before printing them; e.g., '-BM' prints sizes in units of 1,048,576 bytes; see SIZE format below

option.name: --bytes
tip: equivalent to '--apparent-size --block-size=1'

option.name: --count-links
tip: count sizes many times if hard linked

option.name: --dereference
tip: dereference all symbolic links

option.name: --dereference-args
tip: dereference only symlinks that are listed on the command line
equivalent to --dereference-args (-D)

option.name: --exclude
tip: exclude files that match PATTERN

option.name: --exclude-from
tip: exclude files that match any pattern in FILE

option.name: --files0-from
tip: summarize device usage of the NUL-terminated file names specified in file F; if F is -, then read names from standard input

option.name: --human-readable
tip: print sizes in human readable format (e.g., 1K 234M 2G)

option.name: --inodes
tip: list inode usage information instead of block usage

option.name: --max-depth
tip: print the total for a directory (or file, with --all) only if it is N or fewer levels below the command line argument; --max-depth=0 is the same as --summarize

option.name: --no-dereference
tip: don't follow any symbolic links (this is the default)

option.name: --null
tip: end each output line with NUL, not newline

option.name: --one-file-system
tip: skip directories on different file systems

option.name: --separate-dirs
tip: for directories do not include size of subdirectories

option.name: --si
tip: like -h, but use powers of 1000 not 1024

option.name: --summarize
tip: display only a total for each argument

option.name: --threshold
tip: exclude entries smaller than SIZE if positive, or entries greater than SIZE if negative

option.name: --time
tip: show time of the last modification of any file in the directory, or any of its subdirectories
show time as WORD instead of modification time: atime, access, use, ctime or status

option.name: --time-style
tip: show times using STYLE, which can be: full-iso, long-iso, iso, or +FORMAT; FORMAT is interpreted like in 'date'

option.name: --total
tip: produce a grand total

option.name: -k
tip: like --block-size=1K

option.name: -m
tip: like --block-size=1M

global_option.name: --help
tip: display this help and exit

global_option.name: --version
tip: output version information and exit
